text.en: This Order may be cited as the Asian Development Bank Act (Amendment) of section 3 of Chapter 201.
The Asian Development Bank Act is amended by repealing section 3 and by the following new section therefor - to subscribe to shares of Bank.

The Minister, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang hereby authorised to subscribe on behalf of the Government{a) to shares of the original authorised capital stock of the Bank in with paragraph 1 of Article 5; {b) where the original authorised capital stock of the Bank is increased in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 5, to a proportion of the increase of stock as provided in that paragraph; and {c) where the shares of Brunei Darussalam have been increased at the request of the Government in accordance with paragraph 3 of 5, to the amount of such increase.". day of Muharram, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the of December, 2010 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENG£RAN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
